title: Keeper
description:
For those who’ve outgrown traditional DIY tax filing software, there’s Keeper.

Keeper combines AI and human accountants to handle the most complex tax situations -- from self-employment and freelance income, S-Corps, rental properties, K-1s, investments, stock options, and more. Our smart tax platform ensures your tax return is optimized with 100% accuracy, so you capture every deduction, credit, and tax-saving opportunity possible.

Intelligent tax prep: Identify deductions, credits, and other tax-saving opportunities that traditional tax filing software misses.

- Upload a prior year return to uncover missed opportunities
- Connect your banks or credit cards securely to track tax deductible expenses year-round
- Get a real-time estimate of your tax liability

Expert-led guidance & support: Our in-house tax pros are here to advise, review, and sign off on every tax return.

- Book a video call with your dedicated tax expert
- Get instant answers 24/7 with our AI tax assistant trained on tax law

File your taxes with confidence: Our powerful tax software does the heavy lifting to prep your return and uncover maximum tax savings. Then, human accountants review every detail before filing.

- File from your phone or computer
- File with the IRS and all 50 states
- 300+ checks to make sure you get every credit & deduction
- Smart audit protection included
